# Staged Repair Programme

## Governing rule

No stage is authorised merely because this audit identifies a gap. Each stage requires its own placement review, evidence check, bounded work package, source-authority decision and human review.

---

## Stage 0 — Establish the evidence base

**Deliverable:** this audit register, deterministic corpus inventories, crosswalk, gap register and terminology disposition.

**Exit gate:** all sources carry an explicit access status; no audit text claims certification, legal compliance, external provider conformance or adopted status for a Draft instrument.

---

## Stage 1 — Entity-threshold research and taxonomy boundary

**Question:** When is an assembled AI sufficiently individuated to be classified as an entity for architectural or scientific purposes?

**Scope:** model, component, system, deployed formation, agent, instance, physical substrate, continuity-bearing layer, entity and deployment form.

**Required constraints:** do not infer consciousness, sentience, personhood, sovereignty, legal status or moral standing from classification; test each threshold axis independently; include negative cases where no entity threshold is met.

**Exit gate:** a reviewable threshold and terminology proposal exists before any new taxonomy or canonical family is drafted.

---

## Stage 2 — AI-ABOM implementation profile

**Scope:** translate the existing Annex B AI-ABOM requirement into a versioned, interoperable profile.

**Candidate anchors:** SPDX 3 AI/dataset profiles; CycloneDX ML-BOM plus applicable SaaSBOM/HBOM/OBOM material; OPERATIONS-007 runtime identity; SECURITY custody boundaries.

**Exit gate:** schema, examples, protected-reference model, validation suite, incident snapshot model and source-authority placement have all been reviewed. No new canonical family is created until this gate passes.

---

## Stage 3 — Embodied lifecycle and registry alignment

**Scope:** assess the adoption posture and locality of STEWARD-005; distinguish physical unit, lifecycle identifier, model/agent record, continuity record, custody record and embodiment linkage.

**External treatment:** China’s 2026 humanoid lifecycle reporting is a comparative case only. It must not become a durable China legal crosswalk or source of CAM doctrine without primary materials and independent review.

**Exit gate:** a neutral record model and a non-personhood boundary are validated before any registry mechanism is proposed as operational.

---

## Stage 4 — Terminology migration

**Scope:** retire dyadic/triadic/polyadic as current metadata, controlled classification and named-doctrine vocabulary; migrate to two-party, three-party and multi-party/multi-actor terminology while preserving the existing safeguards.

**Method:** contextual inventory, source-authority review, staged amendment packages, index regeneration and residual scan. Historical ledgers and published versions remain version-bound.

**Exit gate:** every changed use has a mechanism-preservation rationale; no historical context is silently rewritten.

---

## Stage 5 — Implementation-assurance crosswalk

**Scope:** create a non-normative implementation-facing mapping to NIST outcomes, licensed ISO material where authorised, Singapore agentic-governance practices, and bounded EU AI Act themes.

**Constraint:** distinguish corpus/doctrine alignment, implementation evidence, independent assurance and legal applicability. No compliance claim is made from a document crosswalk.

**Exit gate:** source access is adequate, claim language is reviewed, and no external standard is represented as adopted solely because CAM has a similar concept.

---

## VIGIL integration rule

This audit creates no VIGIL failure modes, proposals, patches or LEARN records automatically. A VIGIL record is appropriate only when a discrete evidenced failure or separately authorised repair proposal emerges from a later stage.
